items.title: Milford Dolliole Interview, 1965-05-22
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Was that before Zuddy or after Zuddy? That was before Zuddy. Before Zuddy.

ctx.x: Oh, he used to be, he played with Chris Kelly while, and then he was a show drummer. He used to play in the show all the time, at the Lyrics Theater.
At the Lyrics. I mean Robichaux's band. Yeah. Was that before Zuddy or after Zuddy? That was before Zuddy. Before Zuddy.
Yeah. And then Joe Lindsey, I remember him, he was a good drummer.
